key_insights: Wilaya 42 is SIDI BEL ABBES (not M'Sila which is Wilaya 28)
Sidi Bel Abbès is dominated by agro-food industry due to its cereal farming and viticulture vocation
Presence of Algeria's largest military base generates significant dedicated services economy
Leather/tanning sector is historically rooted in the region (tanneries since colonial era)
Strategic position between Oran, Tlemcen and Tiaret favors commerce and logistics
Family SMEs form the backbone of the local economy
Strong export potential in agro-food products (olive oil, honey, dried fruits, preserves)
Sidi Bel Abbès Industrial Zone concentrates several processing enterprises
Local viticulture produces nationally and internationally recognized wines
RC numbers follow format: 42/XX-XXXXXXXXX where 42 = wilaya code
